top_story: A US court’s sentencing of Asif Merchant to more than 27 years for plotting to kill Donald Trump on Iran’s behalf reinforces how the shadow of Qassem Suleimani’s killing still drives retaliatory networks far beyond the region, keeping US-Iran confrontation active in legal and security arenas rather than open battlefield form.
